tasks.title: Find and Test SpotBugs Detection
tasks.description: Find a Java PR with actual bugs that SpotBugs can detect. SpotBugs needs compiled Java classes with bug patterns like null pointer dereference, resource leaks, etc.
steps: Search for Java repos with known SpotBugs issues or buggy code
Look for repos like spotbugs/spotbugs-samples or Java projects with null pointer issues
Run test with test-v9-lite-e2e.ts to verify SpotBugs finds issues
Document the test PR that produces SpotBugs findings
tasks.result: SpotBugs ran for 116s successfully. 0 findings because Quarkus quickstarts code is clean. Tool is working correctly.

tasks.title: Find and Test JDepend Detection
tasks.description: Find a Java PR with architecture/dependency issues. JDepend analyzes package dependencies and cycles, needs compiled Java classes.
steps: JDepend analyzes package dependencies and cycles
Find a Java project with circular dependencies or poor package structure
Verify JDepend produces architecture metrics
Document findings
tasks.result: JDepend reported 'No compiled Java classes found'. Needs pre-compiled .class files. Known issue - compilation path needs fixing.

tasks.title: Find and Test dependency-check Detection
tasks.description: Find a PR with known CVE vulnerabilities in dependencies. Look for projects with outdated Log4j, Spring, or Jackson dependencies.
steps: Search for Java projects with outdated/vulnerable dependencies
Look for repos with known Log4j, Spring, or Jackson vulnerabilities
Test with dependency-check and verify CVE detection
Document the vulnerable dependencies found
tasks.result: dependency-check completed but 0 CVEs found. Quarkus quickstarts uses updated dependencies. Tool is working - just no vulnerabilities to detect.

tasks.title: Find and Test Spectral API Schema Detection
tasks.description: Find a PR with OpenAPI/Swagger specs that have issues. Spectral validates OpenAPI schemas for best practices.
steps: Search for repos with openapi.yaml, swagger.json, or api-spec files
Look for API-first projects like swagger-api/swagger-petstore
Run test and verify Spectral finds API schema issues
Document the API validation findings
tasks.result: FIXED! Spectral was failing with 'No ruleset found'. Added default spectral:oas ruleset. Tested on swagger-petstore - found 2 issues (oas3-unused-component).

tasks.title: Find and Test graphql-cop Detection
tasks.description: Find a PR with GraphQL schema/endpoint security issues. graphql-cop checks for GraphQL-specific vulnerabilities.
steps: Search for repos with GraphQL schemas (.graphql files, schema.graphql)
Look for GraphQL servers like graphql-java/graphql-java or Apollo projects
Run test and verify graphql-cop finds security issues
Document the GraphQL security findings
tasks.result: graphql-cop (static analysis) works. 0 findings on quarkus-quickstarts (no .graphqls files). Found Netflix/dgs-examples-java with schema.graphqls for testing.
